method.name: bounded_two_frame_metric_seed
method.design: Scan verified pairwise edges once, aggregate sparse canonical temporal frame pairs, rank by match count with deterministic frame-id ties, and probe at most the configured number of pairs/orientations. For each source endpoint, reuse same-frame stereo triangulate_frontier; build target 2D-3D observations from existing tracks and solve with the existing GeneralizedPnPRansac. Require sensor diversity, minimum inliers, positive depth, reprojection, metric baseline, and temporal-parallax gates. Restore probe state after every trial and replay only the best pair transactionally before normal frontier growth.
method.candidate_state_complexity: O(E) sparse verified-edge aggregation plus O(F + observations) persistent mapper state; no frame Cartesian product or N^2 proxy
method.trial_state_policy: reused and discarded per probe; one baseline restoration, no trial-count track clones
method.dynamic_correspondence_mode: incompatible: this seed requires legacy metric source tracks and existing track observations; no dynamic-ownership result is inferred
method.solver_policy: no new solver; existing same-frame stereo triangulation and GeneralizedPnPRansac only

tests.default_off_source_and_cli: prototype removed; default behavior restored to HEAD

two_frame_candidate.local_seed_gates: accepted by the bounded probe gates; the 0.002086812 m baseline and 0.062470 degree parallax are nevertheless weak

promotion_gate.decision: The candidate is a clear frozen-1k quality failure despite retaining full registration.

ten_k.reason: The two-frame seed failed the required 1k RMSE, p95, and reprojection gates; no 10k run or artifact is claimed.

decision.source_policy: remove all prototype source, CLI wiring, and tests; keep HEAD default behavior
decision.conclusion: Rejected. This is a stereo-PnP proxy and does not refute COLMAP GR6P/GR8P itself; this route is closed. stereo-PnP proxyでありCOLMAP GR6P/GR8P自体を否定しないが、この経路は終了。
